text:
incident-bot: 🔔 HIGH PAGER: GPU autoscaler not reacting — queue depth rising on inference-prod (detected at 22:05 UTC)

maria: seeing big enqueue on gpu-inference-queue-prod, 4x normal. latency spike in /v1/generate. Customers reporting 500s and timeouts. paging oncall.

jon: looking — HPA for inference-workers shows CPU ok but custom metric (prom/hpa_gpu_queue_depth) is stale, last scraped 22:00. prometheus scrape-latency spiking.

maria: confirm, our autoscale path relies on prometheus -> k8s-metrics-adapter. If adapter is lagging, HPA won't scale. Any recent deploys to metrics pipeline? @deepak

deepak: I rolled a prometheus config change ~21:50 to limit series cardinality. Logs look fine, but metrics-adapter logs show 429s from prometheus and several timeouts. pastes:

```
metrics-adapter-0 logs:
E0324 21:58:12.321 adapter.go:219] query "prometheus/api/v1/query" failed: 502 upstream read timeout
E0324 22:03:41.112 adapter.go:219] scrape error: context deadline exceeded
```

sophia: ops-bot just bubbled a K8s event: kube-apiserver -> apiserver quorum high latency in us-east-1. Could be network blips causing adapter->prometheus queries to time out.

maria: customer impact: low-tier latency increases, a couple of enterprise customers reported degraded inference throughput. No full data loss but elevated error rate. Prioritizing mitigation to restore autoscaling.

jon: immediate mitigation options:
- restart metrics-adapter to flush stuck queries
- temporarily bump HPA minReplicas and set a manual scale-up to absorb queue
- route non-critical traffic to burst/dedicated pool to free GPUs

deepak: I'll restart metrics-adapter in prod namespace now. Doing rolling restart.

(ops-bot): command run: kubectl -n redwood-system rollout restart deploy/metrics-adapter

deepak: metrics-adapter restarted. logs now show successful queries, but backlog of metrics remains. HPA still hasn't triggered since metric history is thin.

maria: manual scale to avoid user-visible errors. I'll patch HPA to set minReplicas=8 (was 3). Command:

```
kubectl -n inference-prod patch hpa inference-workers -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 8}}' --type=merge
```

maria: applied. Also doing an emergency scale on the nodepool to allow more GPUs:

```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment gpu-nodepool --replicas=12
```

jon: adding a short-term route: divert low-priority batch jobs to the burst cluster. Updating router rules now.

anna: I pushed router config change, weight 0.15 to burst-pool for requests with header x-rlow. This should reduce new load on inference-prod by ~15%.

maria: seeing queue depth plateau and starting to recede. 1xx->2xx transitions on internal dashboard. Latency trending down from 2.1s median to 1.2s.

sophia: prometheus scrape latency back to normal; adapter queries responding. HPA now receiving metrics.

jon: HPA observed new metric values and has initiated scale-up to 10 replicas automatically. Good.

maria: customer impact update: error rate down to baseline, several affected customers sent acknowledgement. Logging ops ticket for follow-up.

deepak: root cause hypothesis: prometheus had transient overload from increased series cardinality after config change; adapter queued queries and hit apiserver timing issues due to regional API latency. Need follow-ups: revert aggressive scraping rule, add rate limiting/backoff on adapter, and better alerting for adapter query 5xx/timeout.

maria: follow-ups assigned:
- deepak: audit prometheus scrape configs and revert the problematic rule (ETA 3h)
- jon: add adapter 5xx/timeouts alert to SRE runbook (ETA 2h)
- sophia: create dashboard panel showing adapter->prometheus latency and last-success timestamp (ETA 1h)
- anna: validate router weight rollback plan and ensure burst pool costs cap (ETA 2h)

jon: handoff: i'm going offline in 30m. maria, you're primary for the next shift? Sophia will be second oncall.

maria: taking handoff. I'll monitor for 1 hour and then formal handoff to @sophia.

incident-bot: INCIDENT #INC-2026-324 created, severity: high. Linked postmortem required. Please add timeline and impact summary.

maria: I'll create the initial incident doc with timeline and customer impact summary. Attaching logs and commands used.

sophia: good catch. Suggest we also add a quick automatic fallback: if metrics-adapter latency > 30s, trigger a playbook that sets HPA minReplicas to safe level and notifies oncall — reduces time-to-mitigation.

deepak: agreed. I'll draft the playbook and a PR for adapter backoff. Also planning a chaos test for prom-adapter network blips.

maria: thanks team. continuing monitoring. will post handoff update in 30m with stabilization metrics.

(ops-bot): reminder: cordon-drain plan for scaled-up nodes? none needed now, we just created nodes. keep an eye on capacity.

maria: last update before handoff: queue depth at 22% of peak, latency within SLO. handing off to sophia in 10. Closing pager for now but keeping incident open for postmortem.

sophia: ack, taking over. please DM if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: pager cleared for INC-2026-324 at 22:13 UTC (auto).
